title: Add a reference character image to your Seedance 2.5 prompt to make fashion…
content: Add a reference character image to your Seedance 2.5 prompt to make fashion videos look more cinematic and keep the character’s appearance consistent.
tips: Add a reference character image to your Seedance 2.5 prompt to make fashion videos look more cinematic and keep the character’s appearance consistent.
